factions.name: Surviving Humans
factions.notes: Berlin cell forming. Other resistance nodes in São Paulo, Seoul.

factions.name: The Vorath
factions.status: Active occupation. Harvester ships in orbit. Taker drones in cities.
factions.notes: Resource harvesters. Hivemind. Internal split between Cultivators and Purge Faction.

factions.name: The Shriven
factions.status: Active research. Node clusters in orbit. Contact attempts beginning.
factions.notes: Digital entities. Obsessed with the System. Non-violent unless threatened.

factions.name: The Pale Court
factions.status: Observing. Suspected defector on surface. Holding arrangement with Vorath.
factions.notes: Ancient civilization. Architects of the System. Bound by non-intervention compact.
